_pre_fabla: Ručne písané, anglicky, 3 až 6 položiek (stránka ukáže prvých 6). Každá: nazov, co (čo robíme a prečo), vysledok (čo vyšlo alebo nevyšlo, s číslom), stav (running, waiting, reworking, stopped, failed, worked, planned), od (RRRR-MM-DD alebo null, kým sa nezačalo) a rozhodnutie, voliteľne odkaz {url (/cesta/ alebo https://), text, produkt} pre Umami udalosť live_to_product, zdroj (interný, na stránke sa neukáže). Neúspech sem patrí rovnako ako úspech. Po zmene spusti node ops/riadenie/globus/stranka.mjs.

polozky.nazov: Better titles, tags and categories for 15 Etsy listings
polozky.co: We rewrote the listings in the words people search for and moved several into the right category. We compare their views and orders with listings of the same age.
polozky.vysledok: Starting point: 378 listings, 465 views in total, 5 orders since the shop opened.

polozky.nazov: Etsy ads, second try, only on listings that already sold
polozky.co: Four listings, $1 a day. If ads bring back less than 1.5 times what they cost, or no order, they go off. We decide a week after the start.
polozky.vysledok: The first try did not work: in 13 days ads cost €14.11 and brought back €0.50 to €0.61 for every euro spent. Break-even is about 1.25. It stays on until we switch to the four listings.

polozky.nazov: Videos with your names, made to order on Etsy
polozky.co: Marble race and gender reveal videos where the buyer's names are in the race.
polozky.vysledok: Did not pass our quality check on 19 Oct: Etsy marks digital orders as delivered at once, so our order robot would never have seen them. We are rebuilding it as an editor in the browser, where you type the names and the video is made on your device. Not on sale yet. Halloween did not work either: 15 Halloween listings got 3 views in a week, so we made nothing new for it.

polozky.nazov: Business videos on LinkedIn, not on YouTube
polozky.co: Our YouTube audience is mostly young people, so YouTube keeps only fun videos: simulations, illusions and puzzles. Videos for shop owners go to LinkedIn and to the communities where merchants ask questions.
polozky.vysledok: The planned YouTube Short about 113 Shopify stores was cancelled and goes out on LinkedIn on 22 October.

polozky.co: Agentic Product Check and Orbling are waiting for Shopify's review. Our goal is the first paying merchant.
polozky.vysledok: No installs yet. Clicks on paid products on our websites in the 72 hours before 19 October: 0.
